capabilities.name: tag.context.overview
capabilities.use: Confirm the active nexus and the caller's role.

capabilities.name: aletia.search
capabilities.use: Search nexus documents, and email or chat where indexed in the nexus, as the caller.

capabilities.name: tag.sources.list
capabilities.use: Sources available to the caller, with freshness and authority.

capabilities.name: tag.work.status
capabilities.use: State of TAG work in the nexus.

capabilities.name: tag.expectations.read
capabilities.use: Expectations and their states in the nexus.

inputs.name: organization, acting principal, mandate, nexus, correlation id
question, time frame, named people, projects or documents
inputs.source: the user or the calling skill

inputs.name: available sources with freshness and authority

outputs.name: ranked result set
outputs.description: Per hit: source type, identifier, title, author, timestamp, relevance note, excerpt.
